execution.scope: Measurement adds only birth/push ownership. Must reproduce every initial and old rollout array from entropy_credit001. Separate native rollouts from each completed2688 state and its own saved RNG, not matched-state causal sampling. No update/optimizer step or learning/consumption-clock advance.

control.normalization_scope: Native globally normalized advantages; disjoint cohort squared-energy fractions sum to1. This is descriptive contribution to the sampled surrogate, not variance explained or a causal learning intervention.

treatment.normalization_scope: Native globally normalized advantages; disjoint cohort squared-energy fractions sum to1. This is descriptive contribution to the sampled surrogate, not variance explained or a causal learning intervention.

scope: Each completed model uses its own saved RNG and fresh episodes. This is not matched-state causal AB. Added measurement must reproduce every initial and old rollout array exactly. Native pre-reset birth metadata belongs to the elapsed interval; native pushes after an interval affect the next state. All statistics are descriptive, not proof that simplifying births improves learning.
